pages.text: Four native effects: $(l)Lightfoot$(/l) (higher jump, safe fall), $(l)Glowmarked$(/l) (the target glows), $(l)Sporeblind$(/l) (a spore-clouded slow), and $(l)Rooted$(/l) (heavy slow, no jump).
Brew each from an Awkward Potion + a native ingredient: $(br)Air Gel → Lightfoot$(br)Glow Pollen → Glowmarked$(br)Spore Sac (or Glowcap Spores) → Sporeblind$(br)Living Fiber → Rooted
